### Added
- **The Substrate bootstrap mints a fifth pool, `egress-mitm-ca-pool` (ECDSA P-256) in `ate-system`** (giantswarm/giantswarm#37705). The Substrate line from `1.1.0` (kagent-dev/substrate v0.2.0-beta4) terminates and re-originates every TLS connection an actor opens and injects the agents' credentials into the request at the egress gateway; the egress Deployment mounts this pool and does not start without it. The actors trust its roots through the `egress-mitm.ate.dev` trust bundle kagent projects. A pool that exists is kept, like the other four.
- **`substrate.credentialProvider.namespacePolicies`, the namespaces the Substrate credential provider may read Secrets from, one entry per namespace that hosts AgentTemplates and one for `ate-golden`** (default: the `kagent` namespace for both). The egress gateway of the Substrate line from `1.1.0` injects an agent's credentials from Secrets next to its AgentTemplate; without the grant every model call of the namespace fails. The golden actor of every template boots in Substrate's atespace `ate-golden` and fetches the template's private git skills with the template's credential, so `ate-golden` is allowed the same namespaces; without it the golden boot of a template with a private skill fails with git's 403.
- **A Kyverno PolicyException for the Substrate credential provider (`substrate-credential-provider`, `check-seccomp-strict`)** (giantswarm/giantswarm#37705). The `k8s-credential-provider` Deployment of Substrate 1.1.0 runs non-root with every capability dropped but declares no seccompProfile; without the exception the restricted policy denies it on the fleet. `make verify-kyverno` holds the rule list to the rendered pod spec.
- **`kagent.harness.compaction`, the context compaction of every agent the platform Harness admits** (`tokenThreshold: 24000`, `eventRetentionSize: 4`, the values the Generic agent chart rendered per AgentTemplate). kagent-dev/kagent#2790 put compaction on `Harness.spec.kagent.compaction`; the kagent line from `1.1.0` renders the block from this value and the AgentTemplate has no such field any more.
### Changed
- **`components.kagent*.versionRange` and `components.substrate*.versionRange` are `>=1.1.0 <1.2.0`, `agent-manager.agentChart.semver` is `>=1.5.0 <2.0.0` (was `>=1.0.0 <1.5.0`); the example BOM pins `1.1.0`** (giantswarm/giantswarm#37705). The kagent line's `1.1.0` is upstream `main@1069fd2` (2026-09-24) on the Substrate line's `1.1.0`, kagent-dev/substrate v0.2.0-beta5 plus the carried patches, the contract the values of this release are written for (the egress MITM pool, the registry split, the credential provider's policies, the Harness compaction); the 1.0 lines stay on their `release-1.0` branches for the installations that do not move yet. Generic agent chart 1.5.0 renders no `spec.context.compaction`, which this kagent refuses, so the agent chart floor moves with the lines. Proven on agentlab on the lines' dev builds: platform-test, a2a-test, skills-test public and private, agents-test.
- **`substrate.image.registry` is the registry host only, `gsoci.azurecr.io`, and the new `substrate.image.repository` the path under it, `giantswarm/substrate`** (the Substrate chart's registry/repository split, kagent-dev/substrate `df5265f9`, in the line from `1.1.0`; the chart refuses a registry that carries a path). The derived worker image follows both, `<registry>/<repository>/ateom-gvisor:<floor>`. A mirror moves the registry alone.
